weaknesses.title: ENUMERATE/PREFIXALL/SUFFIXALL/FILL do not mutate named bags
weaknesses.detail: Must LET bag = LAST after every transform or WRITE persists pre-arm plain names. Same non-mutate class as UNION/SHUFFLE.
weaknesses.repro: ENUMERATE bag; LINES bag still unnumbered without LET

weaknesses.title: No structured step identity — armed tokens need peel walk
weaknesses.detail: prod/1.build:pending requires AFTER / + BEFORE : + AFTER . + EQS. GREP build matches buildx. Pass/fail are multi-form identity, not one lookup.

weaknesses.title: COUNTLINE cannot tally status suffixes
weaknesses.detail: COUNTLINE bag ':pending' → 0; need GREP+LINES (substring-risky for short statuses).

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line step bags
weaknesses.detail: Armed steps collapse into one string field.

weaknesses.title: WRITE often omits final trailing newline
PREFIXALL accepts string vars for affix but ZIP sep does not
weaknesses.detail: PREFIXALL bag p with LET p=stg/ works; ZIP a b SEP fails unknown form. Inconsistent string-arg coercion across host forms confuses agents.
weaknesses.repro: PREFIXALL bag p OK; ZIP a b SEP fail

weaknesses.title: No string concat — env/ built via REPLACEALL ENV/ template
weaknesses.detail: Same template class as other boards; ENV token in name corrupts.

workarounds: Pass/fail: peel env/index/status then EQS step name — not GREP name
PREFIXALL string vars OK for env prefix; still use literals for ZIP sep
language_gaps: Consistent string-var coercion for all host multi-arg forms
issues_faced: Armed token identity for pass is fragile peel chain — documents language gap
pass on already-done build correctly misses (pending-only) — soft miss path
GREP build false friend with buildx confirmed
